title: Microsoft's AI lab launches seven of its own models
summary: Microsoft AI, the company's AI lab led by Mustafa Suleyman, launched seven new models of its own, including MAI-Thinking-1, a reasoning model for software engineering and math, and MAI-Code-1-Flash, a small coding model built into GitHub Copilot and VS Code. The rest make and edit images, handle speech-to-text in 43 languages, and do text-to-speech. Developers can use them through Microsoft Foundry and other platforms like OpenRouter, and Microsoft is building them into Microsoft 365.
why_it_matters: More of the AI inside Microsoft tools like GitHub Copilot and Microsoft 365 is now built by Microsoft itself.
